evidence.quote: All My Gods is an alternative bar and community space in Bethnal Green, east London

findings.value: The venue's FAQ says the entrance has a 10cm step, with a ramp available on request. It says it has toilet accessibility but gives no detail. The page describes a step at the entrance, so step-free access is not confirmed.

evidence.quote: Yes we have a 10cm step to get in, with a ramp we can provide if needed.
the whole venue is yours, up to 80 guests

not_found: accessibility.access_page (no dedicated access page; the access answer sits in the FAQs at /faqs)
cost.notes (only a single drink price on the home page, which is not general pricing)
notes: Map and web finders describe the same bar; the editor should merge all-my-gods.facts.json with both. Its own pages give opening hours Wednesday to Sunday. Capacity 80 is the figure its private-hire page gives for the whole venue. The FAQ's toilet line is vague, so accessible_toilet is left empty. The allmygodsbar.com domain named by the map finder was not used.
